entries.claim: DensifyPointCloud number-views is the number of neighbor views used in depth-map estimation; number-views-fuse is the minimum agreeing images required to accept a fused inlier. The configured defaults are 5 and 2.

Increasing multi-view agreement can reject inconsistent points but may reduce completeness. More depth-estimation views can add support or cost; global registration and reprojection diagnostics alone do not identify occlusion or depth noise. Validate, do not assume improvement.
entries.source: Interpretation of K1; not experimental evidence

entries.claim: resolution-level controls image downscaling before depth computation; geometric-iters controls geometric-consistent PatchMatch iterations; fusion-depth-diff-threshold limits allowed depth variation during fusion.

More detailed depth may retain structure at greater time/memory cost; stricter consistency can trade completeness for precision. The current diagnostics cannot establish these as the cause of a scene error.
entries.source: Interpretation of K3; unvalidated causal hypotheses

entries.claim: ReconstructMesh decimate is a surface decimation factor (1 disables decimation); close-holes tries to close small holes; smooth is the count of smoothing iterations.
Less simplification or smoothing may retain details but retain noise; closing holes may increase apparent coverage but invent surface. Counts alone do not show which surface is correct.
entries.source: Interpretation of K5; requires paired geometry evaluation

entries.claim: RefineMesh resolution-level controls image downscaling for refinement; max-face-area is the maximum projected triangle area before subdivision.

Single-scene global metrics do not isolate matching, camera, depth, fusion or meshing causes. prepare is fixed this round; do not claim fixes to those unavailable actions. Evaluation timeout is not a geometric quality measurement.
